vikingCompression.measurementNote: CHARACTER-RATIO ESTIMATE ONLY: Uses line-based string filters (not production Viking retrieval). Token estimate: text.length/3.75 (not model tokenizer). Does not establish actual model token savings, dollar savings, or maintained engineering success.

terminalFilter.measurementNote: SYNTHETIC INPUT: Measures ANSI/spinner stripping on generated test data. Not measured on actual agent tool output. Token savings estimated via character ratio. Does not establish token reduction in agent workflows.

gnapConsensus.measurementNote: SYNTHETIC MICROBENCHMARK: 100 sequential signed steps in temporary repository. No task-level coordination, multi-agent task completion, or competitor baseline measured. Does not establish GNAP benefit for engineering tasks.

contractValidation.measurementNote: LOCAL SERIALIZATION LOOP: JSON stringify/parse + field checks only. Does not invoke authoritative runtime schema validator (e.g., Zod, JSON Schema). Not a measure of contract validation in production path.
